title: Multi Impulse Low Earth Orbit Maneuver Synthesis Through Thrust Measure Primer Vector Conditions and Piecewise Multiple Shooting
summary: This work sets out to apply primer vector theory to optimal impulse maneuvers in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) and adapt it to the types of perturbations encountered in this environment, which is not readily available in the literature. A review of the theory of optimal control and orbital maneuvering is made and in particular, primer vector theory is laid out in detail based on the extension of the thrust control to a measure, including its generalization to conservative and non-conservative perturbation models.
